MedVet is committed to delivering the highest quality, most compassionate specialty and emergency veterinary care available. We focus on our values of Teamwork, Leadership, and Compassion to provide the best outcomes for pets and their loving families. With more than 40 locations across the United States, we treat more than 500,000 patients each year. 

MedVet provides specialty practices for in-depth care and patient management as well as emergency services (available 365 days a year, 24 hours a day). Our staff provides expert specialized care in areas such as anesthesiology, cardiology, dentistry and oral surgery, dermatology, emergency and critical care, integrative medicine, internal medicine, interventional radiology, medical oncology, neurology, ophthalmology, radiation oncology, radiology, rehabilitation services, and surgical services.
